description: This file contains unit tests for the NotificationForwardingPolicy class and associated functions such as parseLocalHourMinute and normalizeLocalHourMinute. The tests verify package filtering modes, quiet hours handling, event rate limiting, and time parsing logic.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicyTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for notification forwarding policies and related time handling functions.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_parsesValidValues
methods.description: Tests parsing of valid time strings into hour-minute representation.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_acceptsStrict24HourDrafts
methods.description: Tests normalization function accepts strictly formatted 24-hour time strings.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_rejectsInvalidValues
methods.description: Ensures invalid time strings are rejected during parsing.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_rejectsNonCanonicalDrafts
methods.description: Checks that non-canonical time formats are rejected during normalization.

methods.name: allowsPackage_blocklistBlocksConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Verifies package blocking under blocklist mode.

methods.name: allowsPackage_allowlistOnlyAllowsConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Verifies package allowance under allowlist mode.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_handlesWindowCrossingMidnight
methods.description: Tests quiet hours logic, especially when quiet period crosses midnight.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_sameStartEndMeansAlwaysQuiet
methods.description: Checks behavior when start and end quiet hours are the same, indicating always quiet.

methods.name: blocksEventsWhenDisabledOrQuietHoursOrRateLimited
methods.description: Test combined conditions that should block notification delivery, including disabled policy, quiet hours, and rate limiting.

methods.name: burstLimiter_blocksEventsAboveLimitInSameMinute
methods.description: Tests that event burst limiter blocks excess events in the same minute.

methods.name: burstLimiter_resetsOnNextMinuteWindow
methods.description: Ensures burst limiter resets limits correctly when moving to next time window.
